title: a-testing-name-is-never-held-in-the-bus-process
intention: The bus client never asks the instance's bus process to hold a testing-named device: RemoteBus.wire_delivery declines a name carrying the testing mark, so a shim a proof stands up on the live bus pulses without wiring, raises nothing, and touches no live device's mail — physics in the client, not a wrapper each proof must remember.
why: Test against live, marked as testing (ruled 2026-09-28, extended 2026-10-04): the live system is the test surface; every test output carries a testing mark so it can be thrown away; everyone not testing tolerates and ignores testing artifacts. Law 4: the pilot kept the testing mark off the live device's mail with a per-proof wrapper; a shim named testing- on the live bus raised LookupError out of its first pulse (measured 2026-10-05). 71d1bbfa98b0 is split per component under RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): every component talks to another only through its public interface; a ticket's build lives inside its own component and its proofs and hollow measure only that component; this is its second child.
how: cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py: import is_testing_name from cairn.tools.base.origin (public since be4a7b3c7caa); RemoteBus.wire_delivery returns None for a testing name before calling hold. The exact diff rides this ticket's build_patch field. One new proof, cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_testing_name_is_never_held_in_the_bus_process.py, already written red. A first build in BaseShim._wire_delivery was measured too broad and rejected (it reddened two bus-machine proofs that wire testing shims inside their own bus process).
falsifier: GREEN when cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_testing_name_is_never_held_in_the_bus_process.py passes all three teeth: (1) a testing-39dbe8e8316b-<8hex> BaseShim on bus_client.reach() pulses twice without raising and no hold request naming it reaches the bus process; (2) every undelivered/read/record_delivery call it makes names its own id; (3) RemoteBus.wire_delivery for an unmarked name still sends exactly one hold naming it, and for a testing name none; and every other proof under cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs plus cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_a_requester_takes_its_reply.py and test_mail_without_a_receiver.py and cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py stay green. RED if any fails. WRONG INTENT if a live consumer needs a testing name held in the bus process (then the testing device needs a shim on disk, not a decline).
watchme: none, because the proof's tooth 1 rides the live bus on every seal, and cairn/devices/system_rackmount/proofs/test_system_rackmount.py (whose wrapper this replaces) exercises the same crossing
children: none, because the change is one guard in one method plus its one proof, already on disk at cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_testing_name_is_never_held_in_the_bus_process.py

D3: SETTLED: the proof cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_testing_name_is_never_held_in_the_bus_process.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 1/3 with be4a7b3c7caa's build applied (2026-10-05: tooth 1 LookupError 'no shim answers to testing-39dbe8e8316b-…' out of the first pulse; tooth 3 a hold was sent for the testing name; tooth 2 green — it is the guard). build_patch:
diff --git a/cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py b/cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py
index 4c4f8b95..d03d05aa 100644
--- a/cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py
+++ b/cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py
@@ -25,6 +25,8 @@ import time
 from datetime import datetime
 from pathlib import Path
 
+from cairn.tools.base.origin import is_testing_name
+
 # cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py → three parents up is the class root.
 _CLASS_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
 _BUS_MODULE = "cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus"
@@ -335,7 +337,16 @@ class RemoteBus:
         return self._call({"op": "verbs", key: device_or_shim, "verbs": list(argv)})
 
     def wire_delivery(self, device_id: str, _deliver=None) -> None:
-        """Delivery happens in the bus process: holding the device there IS the wiring."""
+        """Delivery happens in the bus process: holding the device there IS the wiring.
+
+        A TESTING NAME IS NEVER HELD THERE (ticket 39dbe8e8316b). A ``testing-`` device exists
+        only inside the proof that stood it up; no shim in the bus process answers to it
+        (measured 2026-10-05: the first pulse raised LookupError out of ``hold``), and the
+        proof's own shim reads the testing id's mail and nobody else's. A bus process wiring a
+        testing shim it holds itself is a different act and stays legal — this declines only
+        the crossing."""
+        if is_testing_name(device_id):
+            return None
         self.hold(device_id)
 
     def unwire_delivery(self, device_id: str) -> None:
